verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an in-product AI feature, Query Assistant, which turns natural-language input into Honeycomb queries. It also mentions Canvas investigations that accept skills as instructions, which suggests an in-product investigation assistant, though the docs barely describe it. The MCP server and agent-skills plugin serve external agents, so they don't count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end delegation of multi-step tasks to a built-in assistant, substantive documentation of what Canvas can do, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Query Assistant is a feature that generates Honeycomb queries based on your natural language query (NLQ) input.
Use skills to add instructions or context to your Canvas investigations.
